A '''Flight Wing''' was a unit of organization for [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was equipped with Flight Wings such as the [[301st Flight Wing]] and the [[302nd Flight Wing]] aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']].
